{{Top|leg}}
The '''Justa starport''' was a subterranean complex on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Justa]] orbiting the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Mutanda]]. The port had surface-level docking facilities with space for up to 50 light freighters. Larger bulk transports were assigned orbit around the satellite. It was jointly owned by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]], and [[Blethern Gas Industries]]. A truly corporate facility, ships stationed not owned by these companies were charged up to 200% of the standard cost for the same services. Apart from docking facilities, the starport had a bustling trade city. A great deal of trade was geared to the many hunting expeditions that came to Mutanda since most tourists had a great deal of disposable income. Illegal activities were ignored if they were handled with tact, out of view in secrecy. [[Horansi]] scouts and mercenaries for hire became common within the station.
